description: This file contains the implementation of LogView, a custom Android TextView that outputs formatted log data received through the LogNode interface. It visualizes log messages with various priorities and supports chaining for further log processing.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages formatted with priority, tag, message, and exceptions. Implements the LogNode interface to receive log data and chain to other nodes.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context.

methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context and AttributeSet.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context, AttributeSet, and style.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays incoming log data consisting of priority, tag, message, and throwable; also passes it along the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder if the string is not null, with a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
